{'text': 'Apple 正在為德州奧斯汀的用戶在 Apple Maps 地圖推出令人驚豔的「城市詳細體驗」功能。這標誌着 Apple Maps 地圖在奧斯汀進行一次重大改革，類似於我們在三藩市、芝加哥及倫敦等其他市場所看到的更新。', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple is rolling out its stunning Detailed City Experience in Apple Maps for users in Austin, TX. This marks a robust overhaul of Apple Maps in Austin, similar to what we’ve seen in other markets like San Francisco, Chicago, and London.'}

{'text': 'Apple Maps「城市詳細體驗」改版加入了關於地形、建築物、樹木、道路特徵及主要城市地標的深入細節。其中在奧斯汀包括德州州議會大廈、Q2 球場、布蘭頓藝術博物館、派拉蒙劇院，以及標誌性的國會大橋。', 'paragraph_context': 'The Apple Maps Detailed City Experience revamp adds in-depth details on elevation, buildings, trees, road features, and key city landmarks. In Austin, that includes the Texas Capitol building, Q2 Stadium, the Blanton Museum of Art, the Paramount Theater, and the iconic Congress Avenue Bridge.'}

{'text': '奧斯汀「城市詳細體驗」的好處亦延伸至駕車及步行導航。奧斯汀的 Apple Maps 用戶將會注意到導航指引有所改進、視覺效果更具沉浸感，以及新增的道路標記。這項更新同樣適用於 CarPlay 上的 Apple Maps。', 'paragraph_context': 'The benefits of the Detailed City Experience in Austin also extend to driving and walking navigation. Apple Maps users in Austin will notice improved navigation guidance, more immersive visuals, and additional road markings. This also applies to Apple Maps in CarPlay.'}

{'text': '此外，在下週 Formula 1 美國大獎賽舉行前夕，Apple 正在為奧斯汀的美洲賽道（Circuit of the Americas）推出詳細的 F1 體驗。Apple 今年已在全球各地的 F1 賽事推出類似的體驗，包括整個美洲賽道的詳細賽道地圖及 3D 地標。', 'paragraph_context': 'Additionally, ahead of next week’s Formula 1 United States Grand Prix, Apple is launching a detailed F1 experience for Circuit of the Americas in Austin. Apple has rolled out similar experiences for F1 races around the world this year. This includes detailed circuit maps and 3D landmarks throughout the Circuit of the Americas.'}

{'text': '如果你親身出席 F1 大獎賽，Apple Maps 同樣會提供賽日相關設施、路線導航、步行指示等資訊。', 'paragraph_context': 'If you’re attending the F1 Grand Prix in person, Apple Maps also shows race-day amenities, navigation, walking directions, and more.'}

{'text': 'Apple Maps 在德州奧斯汀的新功能現正陸續推出。你可以在 iPhone、iPad 及 Mac 的地圖 app 率先體驗。由今年起，Apple TV 訂戶可以免費串流觀看所有 F1 賽事。', 'paragraph_context': 'The new Apple Maps features for Austin, TX are rolling out now. You can check them out in the Maps app on iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Starting this year, Apple TV subscribers can stream all F1 races at no extra charge.'}
